info.name: Open Data CKAN Action Resource API

description.content:
Open Data CKAN's Action API is a powerful, RPC-style API that exposes several features.

Datasets are managed as packages of metadata and resources.

All endpoints are available under `/api/3/action/<action_name>`.

Endpoints support POST requests with an application/json or a multipart/form-data body.
  - Use an application/json POST request when nested json parameters are required
  - Use a multipart/form-data POST request when file uploads are required

Read-only endpoints (`*_show`, `*_list`, `*_search` etc.) accept GET requests with query parameters.
Responses are returned in a JSON envelope on success:
```json
{
  "help": "url to complete endpoint help",
  "success": true,
  "result": {...}
}
```
or on errors:
```json
{
  "help": "url to complete endpoint help",
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "__type": "error type",
    "message": "error message",
    "field-with-error": ["first-error", "second-error"],
    ...
  }
}
```
